text:
## FCA Reporting  
### Reportable Complaints  
**Must Report to FCA:**
- Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules
- Complaints about financial services
- Complaints about conduct
- Complaints causing financial loss
- Systemic issues

raw_entities.name: FCA Reporting Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the identification and reporting of complaints to the Financial Conduct Authority. Establishes mandatory reporting obligations for complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules, complaints about financial services and conduct, complaints causing financial loss, and systemic issues.
context: Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Reporting of FCA Rule Breaches
raw_entities.description: Requirement to report to the FCA any complaint that alleges a breach of FCA rules. This is a discrete mandatory reporting obligation under the FCA Reporting Policy.
context: Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Reporting of Financial Services Complaints
raw_entities.description: Requirement to report to the FCA any complaint concerning financial services. This provision ensures complaints about the delivery or quality of financial services are escalated to the regulator.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Reporting of Conduct Complaints
raw_entities.description: Requirement to report to the FCA any complaint relating to conduct. This provision captures complaints about staff or organisational behaviour that may breach regulatory standards.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Reporting of Complaints Causing Financial Loss
raw_entities.description: Requirement to report to the FCA any complaint that results in or alleges financial loss to the customer. This provision ensures material harm events are escalated to the regulator.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Reporting of Systemic Issues
raw_entities.description: Requirement to report to the FCA complaints that indicate systemic issues within the organisation. This provision captures patterns or widespread problems that may affect multiple customers or represent structural compliance failures.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority
raw_entities.description: The UK financial regulator to which complaints meeting specified criteria must be reported. The FCA is the primary recipient of escalated complaints under this policy.
context: Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules

raw_entities.name: Conduct Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk arising from complaints about staff or organisational conduct that may breach FCA rules or regulatory standards. This risk category is addressed through mandatory reporting of conduct-related complaints.

raw_entities.name: Financial Loss Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of customer financial harm resulting from service failures or breaches. Complaints causing financial loss are flagged for FCA reporting to ensure material harm events are escalated.

raw_entities.name: Systemic Compliance Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk arising from patterns or widespread issues within the organisation that affect multiple customers or indicate structural compliance failures. Systemic issues must be reported to the FCA.

properties.scope_summary: Applies to all complaints meeting FCA reporting criteria; excludes complaints that do not trigger any of the five mandatory reporting categories.
